text: **Protein fingerprint transfers to a human proteome atlas, with the RNA coverage pattern.** A 20-protein panel selected on MoTrPAC RII names the tissue of 0.455 of 44 Jiang 2020 samples (donor-bootstrap 95 % CI 0.36–0.55; 13 donors, 5 mapped tissues; k50 0.477, full 0.523; chance 0.143; on the raw reporter scale re-normalised like the RII, k20 rises to 0.734 on 94 samples); marginal conformal coverage with MoTrPAC calibration is 0.068 (CI 0.00–0.14; empty sets 0.932) against a nominal 0.90, and recalibration on 5 donors restores 0.917 at set size 2.954. Human adults, post-mortem, different TMT design — all shifts at once. — `results_multiomic/03_prot_transfer/accuracy_overall.csv`, `conformal_transfer.csv`, `recalibration.csv`
